Brain implants and the fear of thought crimes shape this Joe Rogan Experience segment on the wired future. Companies like Neuralink are putting chips in human brains to help paralyzed people control machines. Rogan and his guest look past the medical promise to the darker uses.

They ask what happens when tech can read signals close to thoughts themselves. Privacy of mind, ads in dreams, and state access to inner life all come up. The guest weighs real near-term science against science fiction. For the wary, the segment maps a future where the last private place may be opened.
